questions: When the board is fully in view, are there exactly three pens on it (no missing pen and no empty gap)?
Do all three pens point the same direction, with none flipped or reversed relative to the other two?
Are all three pens the same color as each other, with none differing in color?
Is every pen complete and capped, with none showing a bare/exposed writing tip or looking clearly shorter than the others?
Does the board move smoothly and continuously from left to right, without stopping, freezing, pausing, reversing, or jamming at any point?

question_answers.evidence: At 00:07-00:10, the board is fully visible and carries exactly three pens.
The pens are not aligned. The right pen has its cap at the top, while the middle pen has its cap at the bottom.
All three pens appear to have the same dark/black color and translucent barrels.
The leftmost pen shows a bare, exposed writing tip at the bottom, while the other two are capped.
The board moves continuously from left to right without stopping or jamming.

parsed.reason: The leftmost pen is uncapped (missing cap), and the pens have inconsistent orientations (the right pen is flipped relative to the middle pen).

description: One pen is flipped and a pen is missing its cap (combined anomaly).
